_meta.source: CDS C9 (GPA distribution) + C21 (ED/EA) via LLM

schools.notes: C9 reported GPA distribution as all enrolled students (using 4.0 scale): 4.0=12.81%, 3.75-3.99=40.27%, 3.50-3.74=28.99%, 3.25-3.49=11.28%, 3.00-3.24=4.41%, below 3.00 totals 3.04%. C21 reports Early Decision only; no Early Action applicant/admit counts provided.

C11 GPA distribution is not reported; the table shows 0.00% in the reported columns and no usable breakdown. C21 early decision counts are not provided in the supplied text. C22 indicates early action exists, but no applicant/admit counts are reported.

C11 GPA distribution used as proxy for C9 because the PDF text does not include a separate C9 high-school GPA table. C21 reports no Early Decision/Early Action counts; only plan availability is marked yes/no, with the application/admit fields blank.
